title: ID0427626-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Screensaver
description:
Reported behavior/issue:   Since the new firmware update, the home screen is no longer
active on these charging stations. The home screen contains the
language selection, price/kWh and the required company info that
must be listed. You can find the configuration of this on the
chargers where firmware version 6.0 is active.
Please activate the home screen again and take this into account
when I ask you to update the other chargers to the new firmware
as well

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0427626-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Home Screen disable CRM:02679000338
additional_info.body:
Hello,
After discussing with our R&D team, the idle screen has been removed to streamline the user experience. This change allows for a more straightforward screen flow, reducing the number of clicks required before charging begins. If no screensaver is selected, the system will default to the outlet selection screen.
As an alternative, I can offer to create a custom screensaver using the image you provided. This can help mitigate the removal of the idle screen.
Please let me know if you'd like to proceed with the custom screensaver or if you have any other preferences.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,
Francois WINCKEL
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Deutschland
Mobil: +49 (1525) 1637094
